text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Well, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Looking forward to working with you, 
Helios!

One day during the camp. A sudden turn of 
events led to Daitaku Helios and 
K.S.Miracle running a mock race.

I'd like to say Daitaku Helios, but 
K.S.Miracle's rapid growth is truly 
remarkable.

Less than six months after her debut, a 
record-breaking victory, an overwhelming 
nine-length triumph... She appeared like a 
comet, almost as if—
And so, the showdown began.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —YEEEEAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!!

As Daitaku Helios surges ahead, K.S. 
Miracle calmly watches her. That state of 
affairs continues for a while, but—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!

With an astonishing final burst that no 
one could have imagined from his usual 
gentle demeanor, K.S. Miracle sweeps past 
to seize victory...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally craaaazy!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Crap, Miracle is way too strong! Wait, 
like, seriously, what is with that 
speed...?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's seriously a miracle, though!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Acknowledging my legs, my speed, makes me 
happier than anything."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because these legs are something everyone 
gave me.
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, back then too—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because this speed of mine was given 
to me by everyone.

The way KS Miracle spokeâas though her 
very existence were merely 
borrowedâweighed heavily on my mind.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"My parents, everyone at the hospital who 
looked after me when I was little... and 
all the people cheering me on."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone who has ever been part of my 
life. Because this life, these legs, were 
given to me by everyone—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
With these legs, I will make a "miracle" 
happen.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A GⅠ victory that the me back then 
wouldn't have even dared to dream of...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll show that miracle to everyone and 
repay them for everything. —Without fail!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Miracle...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-Sorry. I got carried away without 
realizing it.

I don't know the specifics, but she's 
mentioned before that she's in frail 
health. I imagine many people have looked 
after her over the years.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Miracle is, like, for real such a 
sweetheart!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but basically I'm 
runnin' for everybody, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ojo's great and all, but you're amazing 
too. There's no way I could do that!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I really like the way you run, 
Helios, you know?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Your running is... fun, free, and gives 
hope to others.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It excites me. Like something incredible 
is about to happen.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ehh~? You're makin' me blush~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I love Miracle's running style too! It 
totally gets me hyped!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah! Wait, Miracle, what's your next goal!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
As for the big targets, I'm aiming for the 
Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real!? That's the one Ojo's running in 
too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, then I'm definitely going to cheer 
you on! Rooting for both of you~!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Really? If Helios is cheering for me, 
that'll give me so much strength.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, for real, that speed is insane! Can 
your body even keep up with that?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fine! In fact, I'm in the best 
shape I've ever been in.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"In the next race, I might be able to 
surpass my limits...!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sounds awesome, go ahead and surpass them! 
Surpassing gods and demons would be a 
total miracle☆

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm going to give it everything I've 
got.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: With everything I have—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san, what incredible speed...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...That right there... is light—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"—The Sprinters Stakes looks totally 
insane!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Think they'd get mad if I brought in DJ 
gear? I wanna pump this place up so bad~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list:
You're not running in the "Sprinters 
Stakes"?

text_block_list.text:
If she goes to cheer, she won't be able to 
enter the race in the first place. Though 
knowing her, she'd probably say she'll 
cheer while running alongside her...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Thought I'd watch it with 
Palmer-chin.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally stocking up on good vibes 
right now! Plus—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You saw that too, right, Trainy-P? That 
run!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Something like that's gonna go mega viral! 
Totally gotta post it on UmaTok!!

While playfully calling out Daitaku Helios 
as usual, I recalled the expression on 
K.S.Miracle's face—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"In the next race, I might be able to 
surpass my limits...!"

"That sparkling gaze, so full of hope— for 
some reason, it was burned into my 
memory."
